name: mcp-memory-sqlite
description: MCP server — persistent LLM memory backed by SQLite

scripts.build: esbuild src/mcp.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/mcp.js --external:*.node --minify --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/stats.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/stats.js --external:*.node --minify --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/better-sqlite3/build/Release/better_sqlite3.node','dist/better_sqlite3.node'))"
scripts.test: node test/unit.js && node test/integration.js src && node test/integration.js dist
